Usage: drive record <command> [flags]

Record what drive cannot see: the owner's grants, asks and answers, notes, and each session's goal.

The record is the batch's memory: status lists the grants and open asks,
log has every record, and metrics measures the asks. A grant, ask, answer
or note prints the id it recorded, such as A3, which record answer takes.

Inherited flags:
  -h, --help           Show context-sensitive help.
      --batch=NAME     Act in this batch, as drive prints its name, instead of the driver's current
                       one. It may stand anywhere on the line.
      --driver=NAME    Act as this driver, in its current batch: a chat driver is named by its
                       webhook. Where drivers each drive a batch, every command names one. It may
                       stand anywhere on the line.

Commands:
  grant --source=SOURCE --scope=SCOPE
                               Record authority the owner handed over, in their words, with what it
                               covers.
  ask --question=QUESTION --if-unanswered=IF-UNANSWERED <session>
                               Record a question put to the owner, with its recommendation and what
                               happens unanswered.
  answer --took=TOOK <ask>     Record the owner's answer to an ask.
  note <text> ...              Record a note, such as the plan, for the run after a reset to read.
  goal <session> <text> ...    Record what a session sets out to do, in plain terms for the owner.

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    refused: nothing was done; next: says what to run instead
  2    invalid arguments; nothing was run
  3    tried and did not end as asked; the message says what did happen
  4    the session's login was rejected; next: relaunches it on another account, or says to tell the
       owner

Run "drive record <command> --help" for a command's details.
